title: Peanut Butter Cups
description: Homemade bite-sized salted peanut butter cups inspired by the American candy — a chocolate shell filled with peanut butter and finished with sea salt.
steps: Line a 12-hole muffin tray with paper cases.
Melt half the chocolate in a heatproof jug in the microwave in 20-second bursts. Pour into the cases and use a pastry brush to spread chocolate halfway up each case. Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Put a heaped teaspoon of peanut butter into each chocolate mould. Sprinkle with half the salt and freeze for 15 minutes.
Melt the remaining chocolate and pour over each cup, smoothing the top. Sprinkle with remaining salt.
Refrigerate for 2 hours to set. Take out of cases to serve. Keep in the fridge.
notes: Makes 12 cups. Per cup estimate. Keeps in fridge for a week.
